parameters.name: CacheTtlMax
parameters.description: The maximum TTL for cached data retrieved from the origin server. The value ranges from 30 to 86400.

parameters.name: CacheTtlMin
parameters.description: The minimum time-to-live (TTL) for cached data retrieved from the origin server. The value ranges from 30 to 86400.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The domain name.<props="china"> To query the domain name, call [DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>
<props="intl">To query the domain name, call [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the authoritative proxy domain name instance.<props="china"> To query the instance ID, call [ListCloudGtmInstances](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>
<props="intl">To query the instance ID, call [ListCloudGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

**zh**

parameters.name: SourceDnsServer
parameters.description: A list of origin DNS servers. You can add up to 10 servers.

sub_parameters.name: Host
sub_parameters.description: The domain name or IP address of the origin server.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description: The port of the origin DNS server.

parameters.name: SourceEdns
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the origin server supports Extension Mechanisms for DNS (EDNS).
SUPPORT: The origin server supports EDNS.
NOT\_SUPPORT: The origin server does not support EDNS.

parameters.name: SourceProtocol
parameters.description: The origin protocol. Valid values: TCP and UDP. Default value: UDP.
